svg.aria-label: Invoice AI database schema: documents own pages, invoices, ledger entries, processing events and validation issues; invoices own line items, corrections and optional issues and events; cross-checks and the LLM cache stand alone.

g.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector · migration 0001_initial_schema · UUID keys · money as numeric(18,4), never float · deleting a document cascades to everything under it
one → many, required, ON DELETE CASCADE
Search runs on invoices: fts (GIN) for keywords, embedding (HNSW)
for meaning, both with ordinary SQL filters in one query.
left_ref / right_ref are JSON snapshots, so a result
survives reprocessing of the documents it compared.
